open_release.rationale: The paper frames sharing synthetic EHR data as a way around privacy limits on access.

quotes.text: However, various concerns, particularly over privacy, can limit access to and collaborative use of EHR data.
We also empirically observe a limited privacy risk in both identity and attribute disclosure using medGAN.

pipeline_testing.rationale: No testing or format-conformance framing; realism is the stated goal.

ml_augmentation.rationale: Classifiers trained on synthetic data are scored on real test data as a utility check.

quotes.text: We can assume that the closer the performance of LRSk to that of LRRk , the better

statistical_replication.rationale: Dimension-wise probability checks compare each synthetic feature distribution with the real one.

quotes.text: Using R and S, we compare the Bernoulli success probability pk of each

education.rationale: README only gives run instructions, no teaching framing.

benchmarking.rationale: medGAN is the proposed method here; the digest shows no use as another study's baseline or benchmark data.

imbalance_correction.rationale: No minority-class or imbalance experiments appear.
